'''Thane Dregond''' was the [[Chamber President]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamori/Legends|Kamori]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Following a series of [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] which sundered [[City/Legends|cities]] all over the [[Zethusian plains]], Dregond declared the area a disaster zone, qualifying it for governmental disaster relief, and planned to petition the local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] for Imperial aid.
